title: Nations Digital Hospital Concept
summary: A webinar on ‘Nations Digital Hospital Concept’ was held at 6.00 p.m. on 16th June 2021 via zoom. It was organized by the Industrial Application Society (IAS, IEEE) of University of Peradeniya colllaborate with Gen Next. The webinar was conducted by Mrs. Champa Samaraweera and Dr. Ananda Chandrasekara.
